top_signals.title: For many Russians, higher utility bills are latest inflation shock
top_signals.summary: Utility bills in Russia have risen more than 50% since the start of the war in Ukraine in 2022 and more than 13% this year alone.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island on eve of election
top_signals.summary: Oil price steady as Washington says attacks were defensive measure against Tehran’s potential use of surface-to-air missiles
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Australia lifts rates to 18-year high as AI boom, energy costs fuel inflation
top_signals.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its benchmark rate to 4.85% on rising technology costs from AI investment and higher energy prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Europe’s Junk Market Sees Another Loan Pulled as Iqony Axes Deal
top_signals.summary: Banks marketing a €550 million ($616 million) loan refinancing for European energy infrastructure and services company Iqony have pulled the deal after failing to garner enough investor interest amid wider market turmoil.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet crypto thefts on outdated instances
top_signals.summary: The maintainer of BTCPay Server, an open-source cryptocurrency payment processor, has urged users to install the latest version as hackers have been draining "hot wallets" on instances running older versions. [...]
